description.value: Dorothy Quick with Mark Twain, 1907 on ship coming back to America from Europe. ( From Dead Fred site) Mark Twain and Dorothy Quick. 1907. Quick was a girl of 11 in 1907 when she met the famous author on an Atlantic crossing. She was returning to Plainfield, N.J., from Europe with her parents, the Mr. and Mrs. Henry Quick.

When Samuel Langhorne Clemens was born on 30 November 1835, in Florida, Monroe, Missouri, United States, his father, Judge John Marshall Clemens, was 37 and his mother, Jane Casey Lampton, was 32. He married Olivia Louise Langdon in February 1870, in Elmira, Chemung, New York, United States. They were the parents of at least 1 son and 3 daughters.
